[EN] Go to Aheaf and hear the details of the unknown force.

[Your equipment level has to be at least 463 to enter this instance.]
[ES] Ve con Aheaf y escucha los detalles sobre la fuerza desconocida.

[Tu nivel de equipamiento debe ser al menos 463 para entrar a esta instancia.]

[EN] He seems to have discovered a passage that leads inside the Verrak Fortress.

Ask Aheaf for details.

Afterwards, the quest [Important] Kaia’s Anvil will be activated automatically.
[ES] Parece que ha descubierto un pasaje que conduce al interior de Verrak Fortress.

Pídele los detalles a Aheaf.

Después, la misión [Important] Kaia’s Anvil se activará automáticamente.

[EN] Ah, you're here, .

After the Draakon Commanders left this place, I saw an area that I never saw before.

It's right over there. They weren't draakons...and they were definitely not nagas.

Will you go and help me understand what they are?
[ES] Ah, estás aquí, .

Después de que los Draakon Commanders se fueron de este lugar, vi un área que nunca antes había visto.

Está justo ahí. No eran draakons... y definitivamente no eran nagas.

¿Irás a ayudarme a entender qué son?

[EN] Thank you . It's all clear now.

I must go and spread the news to everyone.
[ES] Gracias, . Todo está claro ahora.

Debo ir a esparcir la noticia a todos.
